name: Easton

variables.label: "Two-family", "duplex", "multi-family", "three-family"
variables.value: Zero matches in a full-text search of the 6,576-line regulations

variables.label: Multifamily pathway
variables.value: None — not even by special permit

variables.label: ADU max size (attached)
variables.value: Lesser of 40% of dwelling area or 1,500 sq ft
variables.quote: Forty percent (40%) of the area of the principal dwelling (exclusive of garage, attic, and cellar) or 1,500 square feet, whichever is the more restrictive requirement

variables.label: ADU max size (detached)
variables.value: Lesser of 30%/1,000 sq ft (≥87,120 sf lot) or 20%/800 sq ft (≥34,000 sf lot)
variables.quote: Twenty percent (20%) of the area of the principal dwelling (exclusive of garage, attic, and cellar) or 800 square feet, whichever is the more restrictive requirement

variables.label: ADU owner-occupancy
variables.quote: The owner of the property shall occupy either the principal dwelling or the ADU and an annual affidavit shall be filed by January 31 of each year attesting to such occupancy.

variables.label: ADU bedroom cap
variables.quote: An ADU within/attached to the principal dwelling shall not contain more than two bedrooms

variables.label: Parking, ADU
variables.quote: Accessory dwelling unit                        2.0 spaces in addition to residence requirement

variables.label: Min. unit size
variables.value: Not found as a general minimum beyond ADU caps already captured above

variables.label: Inclusionary zoning
variables.value: None found — no local ordinance. A 2022 developer proposal with 30% affordable (105 units) was DENIED by P&Z under state CGS §8-30g process, not a town mandate

variables.label: Historic overlay
variables.value: None found — no local CGS §7-147a historic district commission/ordinance; only an honorary National Register listing (Aspetuck Historic District, spans Easton/Weston)

variables.label: Demolition delay
variables.value: Up to 90 days for structures on the town's "Index to Historic Homes" (≥50 years old, significant)
variables.quote: To encourage the preservation, documentation, and protection of historically sensitive buildings.

caveat: Of all 17 towns researched, Easton is the single clearest case of total legal exclusion of 2+-family housing — confirmed by exhaustive keyword search, not an oversight. No local PDF mirror exists for Easton, so these facts rest on the search method itself rather than a re-verifiable quote.

hap_score.methodology_note: Computed from the Variables table on this page, not from the NZA data below. Six weighted components (Multifamily Access 30pts, Approval Discretion 10pts, Minimum Lot Size 20pts, ADU Approval Pathway 15pts, Parking Mandate 10pts, Demolition Delay 15pts) are each scored against a fixed, published rubric from a specific cited fact above. Higher = more restrictive.

v2.formula: V2 = sum(district score x acres) / sum(acres) over included districts
v2.method: Each district is scored with the same six-component rubric using only its own rules. The score uses four components that every town can document (multifamily access, approval discretion, minimum lot size, ADU pathway); a district is included only if all four are confirmed. Parking and demolition delay are shown as context but not scored, so towns share one scale. The town V2 score is the land-area-weighted mean of included district scores; acreage is from data/land_area/easton.json. Components with no confirmed input are excluded per district.
